description: This file defines the EmployeeAllowedReportToEmployeeAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for listing employees eligible to be assigned as supervisors or subordinates for a specific employee within the OrangeHRM system. It handles request parameters, applies validation, interacts with employee service layer, and returns a collection of employee models with related metadata.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedReportToEmployeeAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for retrieving a list of employees available to be assigned as supervisors or subordinates for a specific employee, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list available employees, applying filters based on employee ID, name, and access permissions, and returning a collection of employee models with total count metadata.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request parameters, including employee number and optional filtering and sorting parameters.
